name: set-up-and-weld
description: The power source was left on another job's settings. Set it to this joint's spray procedure, 500 in/min (12.7 m/min) wire feed and 29 V for 0.035 inch ER70S-6 wire with 90/10 gas, then weld a continuous 1/4 inch fillet along the near side of the tacked bracket in the horizontal position, from end to end, and fill the crater.
